What 2045 should look like

Phase 12 M2 target boards · free Codex image generation from renders of our own model · three strengths per shot and a kit sheet · 22 Sep 2026

In plain English

Each board keeps our layout (the same blocks, streets, orchards and GCHQ) and shows what it should become as a real photograph. They are targets, not deliverables: the one you pick per shot becomes a short spec (roof mix, materials, colours, tree forms), and the live model is worked towards it and measured against it.

The three strengths differ less than the words suggest: the generator held the layout, so the dial mostly moves materials, roof planting, water and tree mass. Reply with a letter per shot (for example: homes C, campus B, meadow B, panels A, scheme B), or one letter for all.
